reviews.title: Great purchase of previously returned memory
reviews.comment: These ram run perfectly, great quality, and configured automatically by the system. They were from a set that was previously returned and I was worried but for nothing. These are a set I bought to have for backup when I am troubleshooting systems I am building. These actually ran more stable and faster in default settings than the memory I was using for the install!  Buyers of RAM need to check their motherboard and processor QVL lists for compatibility before returning them as defective. I am having compatibility issues with a set of memory sticks that are supposed to be compatible so you never know.  The RGB on the ram look nice also.

reviews.title: Excellent upgrade to my new HP OMEN 40L
reviews.comment: When I ordered my new HP OMEN 40L this month it came with 16GB of this Kingston RGB RAM. I didn't upgrade with additional RAM when I ordered it because Amazon's price is less than HP's so I decided to wait until my PC arrived last week to go from 16GB to 80GB by adding the kit with 2x32GB (Amazon is also a lot less than ordering from the Kingston website). I made sure to stick with the same speed of 5200MT/s since that's how my OMEN was built (2x8GB 5200MT/s) so I wouldn't need to make changes in the BIOS. I'm not into "gaming" (except occasionally playing Fortnite) so I won't need to be messing with over-clocking this PC. These new modules were easy to install and were recognized instantly when I rebooted my PC. I like the HP OMEN PCs because they're easy to upgrade, especially with things like the Kingston RAM. Even if you're not a hard-core gamer, like me, these RGB modules are a nice add-on to a compatible PC. The lighting can be adjusted, and even turned off with your PCs lighting software or Kingston's free download, but these modules are also available as non-RGB.
